purpose: Operational sub-agent framework for improving kernels and the optimizer while preserving the original 3x objective

authority.precedence: This document supplements role operation and selection; it does not override protocol gates or the frozen ledger plan. Actual ledger and process evidence override snapshot statuses.
authority.excluded_alternative: proj_rsi/ is a pre-existing unrelated BF16 framework; not adopted as authority or as a substitute for the protected RSI gates.

parallel_work: CPU tests on separately owned files
execution_model.liveness: An active goal requests future supervisor turns; it is not a running process. Record actual child-agent and GPU process handles separately.
execution_model.trust: Actor strings and artifact hashes support coordination/provenance, not authenticated identity or proof against dishonest local attestations. Root must actually invoke independent agents.

claim serving gain from component results

must_not: convert an upside envelope into a calibrated success probability
repeat rejected variants without new causal evidence
edit incumbent in place during candidate testing
start GPU work without root handoff

owns: raw-sample recomputation and correctness evidence review
outputs: explicit review scope and unresolved conditions
must_not: treat static review as runtime proof
accept identities only because their labels differ
validate a candidate authored or executed by the same actor

roles.actor_assignment: an independent non-author agent; may reuse critic role with a fresh explicit contract
must_not: equate a single kernel win with optimizer improvement
grant optimizer-method promotion while evaluator remains unimplemented

task_contract.completion: Agent returns artifacts and evidence, not a self-declared pass. Root reconciles actual state.
task_contract.file_conflicts: Separate ownership or isolated worktrees; integration by root after reviewing diffs.
task_contract.disagreement: Preserve both findings, locate conflicting evidence, run a discriminating controlled test if permitted; no majority-vote override of correctness/provenance gates.

inner_loop.decision: Choose the attributed cost that can affect the fixed benchmark.

inner_loop.decision: Reject unfalsifiable or infeasible hypotheses before implementation.

inner_loop.artifact: candidate/baseline dependency bundles and source hashes
inner_loop.decision: Count conversion, gather, scratch and epilogue work in candidate cost.
Review invalidated by any source/dependency/plan change; new experiment ID for revisions.

inner_loop.decision: Failure stops candidate testing. No after-the-fact retry; diagnose and preregister a reviewed revision.

inner_loop.decision: Reject clear failure; a screen win is not promotion.

inner_loop.artifact: all frozen shapes and at least two unused seeds/independent sessions
inner_loop.decision: Use current rsi/protocol.json local_gate exactly; recompute from samples.

inner_loop.owner: independent validator; root integrates accepted source separately
inner_loop.decision: Ledger promotion is local only; no source patch application or full-goal completion implied.

inner_loop.artifact: changed prior, failed-candidate archive, next discriminating hypothesis
inner_loop.decision: Treat rejected experiments as evidence; do not silently erase them.

outer_loop.unit_of_change: ranking policy, candidate-generation strategy, experiment design or harness architecture
trigger: many zero-gain trials with a shared failure mode
sequence: freeze portfolio and equal budgets before exposure
promote method only after evaluator implementation and review
outer_loop.current_boundary: Method-trial contract is specified, not implemented. Current CLI deliberately rejects optimizer_method validation/promotion; do not claim autonomous self-improvement of the optimizer has been proven.
outer_loop.bug_fixes: A correctness/isolation repair can be integrated as a reviewed harness fix, but requires fresh runtime control before kernel evidence and is not itself a measured optimizer-ROI improvement.

roi_ranking.status: advisory formula for planner; not an implemented statistical decision engine
roi_ranking.eligibility: 0 if prerequisites, allowed transformations, budget, or required review fail; otherwise1
roi_ranking.benefit: B = p_pass * E[max(log(S_primary),0) | pass] - lambda_downside * p_regress * E[max(-log(S_primary),0) | regress]
roi_ranking.cost: C = GPU_dollars + lambda_tokens * agent_tokens/1000 + lambda_time * engineering_hours; all conversion weights must be declared/frozen by root for a ranking cycle. If weights/costs are unavailable, report the cost vector and ordinal rank instead of fabricating a score.
roi_ranking.uncertainty: Prior quantiles and p_pass are engineering judgments until calibrated; they are not bootstrap confidence intervals. Preserve ranges and sensitivity to weights. Avoid exact scores when estimates are weak.
roi_ranking.scope: S_primary refers to fixed current expert benchmark; translate to serving only after measuring critical-path share with Amdahl. Do not add overlapping candidate gains.
cost_accounting: include JIT compilation, setup and all agents/reviews in method comparisons
record GPU lease walltime separately from provider idle billing
missing token accounting blocks per-token ROI claims, not ordinary kernel research
update_rule: record predicted vs realized speedup and cost
reduce confidence after repeated same-mechanism failures
increase measurement priority when it changes the next decision
reserve a declared small exploration budget for high-upside uncertain rewrites; never bypass validation
examples: Nsight profiling has direct speedup1.0 but positive information value.
Global N/K and N64 sweeps are now low-priority because observed primary-shape regressions contradict their gain priors.
Coupled stage/register work retains a conditional upside prior because counters show a concrete resource constraint; it still may regress.

frozen_portfolio_evaluator.implementation_status: future prerequisite for optimizer-method promotion; no evaluator exists yet
frozen_portfolio_evaluator.control: snapshot of current planner/ranking/search procedure, prompts, candidate catalog and harness
frozen_portfolio_evaluator.treatment: one explicitly changed method component with all other controls fixed
freeze_before_any_holdout_exposure: representative task portfolio and fixed weights
baseline method and treatment method snapshots
development tasks disjoint from evaluation tasks/seeds
kernel correctness/performance gates and full primary/regression suite
initial compilation-cache policy and starting artifacts
multiple independent search seeds and paired order
maximum trials, no adaptive unregistered retries, stopping rule
frozen_portfolio_evaluator.portfolio_definition: Use several genuinely distinct optimization tasks/regimes, not just the winning shape from one kernel. Keep the original kernel evaluation suite intact inside every task; include failures and no-gain outcomes.
frozen_portfolio_evaluator.quality_metric: U = sum_t weight_t * log(S_t_final_validated_vs_fixed_anchor), with sum(weights)=1. No validated improvement yields S_t=1. Count only independently validated final incumbents, not sums of overlapping intermediate wins.
efficiency_metrics: U / total GPU dollars including failures/setup
U / total agent tokens including planner, implementer and reviewers
correctness/provenance failure rate and harmful-promotion count
frozen_portfolio_evaluator.decision: Compare paired portfolio outcomes over independent search seeds, with uncertainty and practical margin preregistered. Require zero weakened gates and independently revalidated kernel wins. A single successful kernel or faster screen is insufficient.
leakage_controls: do not train/tune the method on evaluation task outcomes within the same trial
keep every attempted candidate in the ledger
do not let treatment reuse control-only discoveries or compilation work unless symmetrically permitted
new method revisions require fresh evaluation tasks/seeds, not repeated testing until significant

gpu_ownership.owner: root is sole physical GPU scheduler/executor in this team
gpu_ownership.subagents: CPU/source/review work only unless root explicitly transfers a named executor lease; no independent ssh benchmark launches
gpu_ownership.start: reserve budget and obtain lease only after plan review; record actual container/process handle
gpu_ownership.timeout: deadline stops new admission and triggers root inspection/termination procedure; it does not prove the process exited or release the lease automatically
gpu_ownership.finish: verify container/process/child termination, collect evidence, account actual walltime, then finish/abort with owned token
gpu_ownership.profiling: serialized with all timing, separate artifacts, never mix counter-instrumented durations into speedup evidence

reject: missing or nonfinite samples, incomplete suite, reused holdouts
failure of any normative local gate
local_promote: normative v2 protocol gates all proven
Incremental replacement additionally requires paired candidate-v-current-incumbent evidence under a reviewed evaluator; until implemented, do not bypass the fail-closed promotion guard.
stop_reject_promote.goal_complete: Only full original3x objective proven against frozen benchmark; single-GPU local promotion cannot substitute for full-serving agreement, TTFT and throughput/interactivity validation.

next_queue_snapshot.policy: Do not duplicate volatile ranks/statuses in this protocol. Read live ledger and verify evidence before dispatch. Queue priors are advisory; ledger gates remain authoritative.

known_gaps.status: reviewed unchanged controls exist; renewed control required after harness/runtime changes
known_gaps.remaining: Known launchers cooperate through host flock and canonical lease. Sampling cannot prove continuous exclusivity or prevent an unrelated root process. OCCUPANCY-v1 remains rejected for unverified provenance; do not reuse it.

known_gaps.status: not implemented; promotion guard fails closed
known_gaps.reason: Beating the original fixed anchor does not prove a candidate improves the current incumbent.
known_gaps.required: Preserve fixed-anchor measurements for the3x goal AND independently validate incremental replacement against the actual current incumbent. Do not replace a stronger incumbent with a weaker anchor-beater.
Implement/review portfolio execution, costs, uncertainty and independent holdout validation before claiming improved optimizer efficiency.

operational_cycle.scope: CPU-only immutable handoff contracts and advisory next-action status; root invokes actual sub-agents and owns all GPU actions.
commands: python3 -m rsi.cycle init --spec rsi/cycle.example.json --manifest results/rsi/cycles/example.json --ledger results/rsi/ledger.json --queue docs/optimization-queue.json --gpu-state results/rsi/gpu-lease.json --root .
handoff_sequence: Read actual ledger, queue, agent states, and GPU coordinator. Inspect any active/expired lease before scheduling.
Assign genuinely separate planner/implementer/critic actors and disjoint write ownership. Freeze existing input hashes and task contract before dispatch.
Dispatch through collaboration tools. Record returned agent IDs and artifact paths; status output never spawns a worker.
Root verifies outputs and hashes. Freeze a new handoff manifest when new artifacts become review inputs; never treat anticipated outputs as already reviewed.
Independent critic reviews exact candidate/plan; root runs only admitted, bounded, exclusive GPU work.
Root collects raw evidence and terminal proof. Independent validator applies existing ledger gates, then planner records realized gain/cost and reranks.
operational_cycle.revision: A changed required input invalidates the handoff; preserve old manifest and create a newly reviewed revision. Queue/ledger snapshot drift alone is context to reconcile, not permission to reuse stale candidate review.
operational_cycle.completion: Artifact existence, task completion, numerical correctness, local promotion, and full goal achievement are different states. Only authoritative evidence establishes each.
operational_cycle.no_daemon: This framework supports agent-directed cycles within live supervisor turns. It does not establish unattended persistent execution.
operational_cycle.budget: Hourly authorization is $5/hour. Ledger admission allocation is distinct from total cloud billing. Account failed runs/setup separately and report idle cost uncertainty; a task manifest grants no spending authority.
operational_cycle.maintenance: Framework changes require a separately scoped, independently reviewed maintenance task with regression tests; freeze a new manifest after integration. A passing cycle check is provenance/coordination evidence, never proof that the checker or benchmark is correct.
operational_cycle.example_scope: cycle.example.json is a CPU research/design handoff example, not a reviewed GPU execution plan. If its selected queue item is already ready for measurement, status deliberately reports missing executor contract and ready=false. Freeze an actual execution handoff only after existing review/lease prerequisites are satisfied.

per_attempt: measured result and exact comparison scope
GPU walltime and dollar accounting; tokens when available
next discriminating test or reason to park
failure_learning.rerank_trigger: Every terminal experiment, meaningful profile, or disproven premise; retain failed attempts and original priors.
failure_learning.method_trigger: Repeated zero-gain trials, calibration failures, or dominant setup/review cost motivate a separately reviewed method hypothesis; no method-promotion claim from a single kernel win.
